question: #11226 at 4432e831: does attach reorder plain elements by keyboard, with a focus ring, an insertion line and an announcement per step? Does the List reorder still behave as on main?

method.device: 1280x800, scale 1, mouse and keyboard; light and dark
method.keyboard: focus starts on the page; Tab to the first grip or handle, Space, ArrowDown twice, then Escape; for attach, a second page ends with a mouse click on the hint's Done
method.drag: mouse down on the first row's handle, 2 small moves, then 12 moves to two row pitches below, wait, release
method.liveRegion: Core's two live regions ([data-astryx-live-region=polite|assertive]); every text they take, verbatim, with the time since the step began
method.ring: pixels that change between the rest still and the focused still, on scan lines across the straight part of each edge of the focused control; each band row's pixel against the unchanged pixel just outside the band and just inside it (WCAG contrast ratio)
method.step: each step waits 450 ms and two frames before its still and its record
method.attachDrag: mouse down on the first grip, 2 small moves, then 12 moves to two card pitches below, wait 400 ms, release, wait 450 ms; the polite and assertive regions watched throughout
method.gripGlyphs: Attach Plain Elements on the head: each grip button's box, and the box of its glyph span and of the span's text range (getBoundingClientRect), at rest
method.dragPreview: Core/List Reorderable: during a mouse drag of the first row two row pitches down (as in listdrag), the aria-hidden preview row's computed and inline style, and the source row's
